records.title: feat(xtask): mark CI-enforced commands in the command catalog
records.release_claim: the command catalog identifies which xtask checks are load-bearing CI gates and mechanically detects workflow drift
records.reason: Exact-candidate qualification and contributor readiness depend on distinguishing enforced checks from advisory commands, but the field is not shipped RIPR runtime semantics.
records.non_claim: A catalog marker does not make an advisory command blocking or prove a check passed on a candidate.

records.title: docs(agents): name implementation slices as PR scope authority and remove a phantom CI skill
records.release_claim: fresh and resumed agents recover PR-local scope from retained ImplementationSliceV1 records and use the actual CI polling discipline
records.reason: The selected tree deleted the goal scheduler and names slices as the durable PR scope authority; omitting this correction leaves the operating documentation on a nonexistent skill and incomplete resume chain.
records.non_claim: Implementation slices do not own live assignment, check state, or repository-wide scheduling.

records.title: docs(xtask): synchronize PR automation with the real command catalog
records.release_claim: PR automation and the generated precommit report name the commands the selected tree actually implements and executes
records.reason: The prior document omitted roughly half the catalog, named deleted commands, and listed nonexistent future write modes; review also found the generated report itself omitted two executed checks.
records.non_claim: The long command inventory does not select work or imply every command is CI-enforced.

records.title: docs(agents): downgrade the handoff protocol from contract to guidance until validation exists
records.release_claim: the repository does not present an unvalidated handoff format and nonexistent context commands as enforced product behavior
records.reason: The old prose claimed a machine-checked operating contract that the code and command catalog did not implement. The selected source-of-truth posture requires an explicit guidance-only boundary.
records.non_claim: This does not implement the future typed handoff protocol or its validator.
